versions.title: Screenshot gallery + F2 copies to clipboard

New: Screenshot gallery: the Screenshots tab is now a grid of thumbnails. Right-click a picture to Copy image, Open, Show folder or Delete (it asks you to click twice). Double-click opens a picture, and the mouse wheel changes page.
F2 copies to the clipboard: take a screenshot with the normal Minecraft key (F2) and the image is also copied to your clipboard, ready to paste into Discord with Ctrl+V. Nothing is taken twice.

Color picker in the Gradient Generator: click the bar under any color box to open a picker with a saturation / brightness square, a hue slider and a grid of quick colors (the ? button picks a random color). Typing a hex code still works, and the picker follows what you type.
HUD key reminder: the MineBerry Client menu now always shows which key hides and shows the whole HUD (Y by default). It also appears in the Settings tab, and follows the key if you rebind it.
Changed: The F9 screenshot key is now an optional Extra screenshot key and is unbound by default. If you already use F9, it keeps working. You can change or remove it under Options > Controls > Key Binds.

Fixed: The update popup now really opens on the title screen when a newer version is out, and you get the chat message when you join a world. Before, the update was only found after opening the Control Center.
The update popup no longer covers the Terms of Use or this What's New window. It waits until the title screen is free.
On your very first launch, the update check now starts as soon as you click I Agree.
New: Modrinth link: the update popup, the chat message and the Tools tab now show a GitHub and a Modrinth button side by side, so you can download from the site you prefer.

Don't remind me: the update popup has a checkbox. Tick it and the popup and chat message stay quiet for that version. When a newer version comes out, you get notified again. You can still check by hand in the Tools tab.

Removed: Spawn Escape was removed. The automatic pit guard is gone, so a friend's tpa can no longer send you to /spawn by mistake. The radial menu (hold V) still has /spawn for a manual escape.
TP Danger Escape was removed. It could not tell friends from enemies, so it sometimes sent /spawn when a friend teleported you to them.
The U key (hide or show the two escape boxes) and their HUD boxes are gone too. Your saved settings for them are cleaned out of the config automatically.

New: Terms of Use: the first time you start the game with the mod, a short agreement opens. Click I Agree to start using the mod. By agreeing you accept that the mod developers are not held accountable for anything that goes wrong. Players who update from an older version see it once too.
If you click I Disagree, the mod stays off: no feature, key or HUD works. Every time you try to use a feature, the agreement opens again so you can change your mind.
Scoreboard: the sidebar scoreboard now has a card in the HUD menu (Right Shift). Hide it with the toggle, or resize it from 50% to 250% with the new row of buttons in Edit HUD Layout.

Spawn Escape and TP Danger Escape: their status boxes are now regular HUD boxes. Hide them, drag them anywhere and resize them like the other HUD boxes. The modules keep working while the box is hidden.
Resize any HUD box: scroll the mouse wheel over it in Edit HUD Layout. Right-click a box to put its position and size back. Sizes are saved in your HUD profiles.

Hide the two escape boxes with a key: a new key (U by default) hides or shows the Spawn Escape and TP Danger Escape boxes. Both modules keep working while the boxes are hidden. Rebind it under Options > Controls > Key Binds.
Delete HUD profiles: every profile in the HUD menu sidebar now has an x button. The last profile can't be deleted.
Removed: The Right Alt key for /spawn was removed. Spawn Escape now only has the automatic pit guard. The radial menu (hold V) still has /spawn.

Improved: The mod description now reads "An essential Fabric mod for MineBerry and MinePeak".
The Website button in Mod Menu now opens the new Modrinth page (modrinth.com/mod/mineberryessentials).
Removed: WorldEditCUI was removed from the mod.

New: Tournament HUD: add your friends by username and a box on your screen shows their last chat messages in full, and whether they are alive, dead or left, with an Alive count on top. Off by default, switch it on in the Tools tab.
Dead is read from the server's death and elimination lines and from spectator mode, never from player chat. Statuses start fresh when a round starts or you join a server.
Radial Menu: hold V and a pie menu opens around your crosshair with quick commands (/spawn, /tpa and /tpaccept). Move to a slice and let go of the key to run it.
It follows Tournament Mode and PvP Command Lock, so a blocked command stays blocked.
Improved: Spawn Escape and TP Danger Escape now show a note when you switch them on: they work well, but can sometimes send /spawn when a friend teleports you to them (tpa).
Fixed: Fixed Safe Logout and PvP Command Lock turning on when the server announced that ANOTHER player left the game in PvP mode and was killed.
Fixed a player typing "entered pvp mode" (or similar) in chat switching on Safe Logout, PvP Command Lock and the abuse alert. Only the server's own messages count now.
Old configs are updated automatically: the PvP start pattern no longer matches every line that contains "PvP mode".

versions.title: Tournament Mode and PvP Command Lock

New: Tournament Mode: blocks every command so nobody gets teleported out of a tournament by accident. Off by default, switch it on in the Safety tab.
PvP Command Lock: while you're in PvP mode, only /r, /msg, /m and a few other chat commands work.
Safe Logout: an "I'm safe - unlock" button in the pause menu ends the guard right away.
Improved: Safe Logout and PvP Command Lock let go by themselves after 3 minutes if the server's "out of PvP mode" message is missed.
The "out of PvP mode" message is now also read from the action bar.

New: Screenshot: press F9 to take a screenshot and copy it to your clipboard as an image, ready to paste into Discord.
Screenshots tab: see your screenshots, copy or open any of them.
Chat Search: press F8 to search your chat history. Copy any line with one click.
Improved: Safe Logout now follows the server's PvP mode messages instead of a 30 second timer.
Fixed: Safe Logout no longer re-enters combat after the server says you're out of PvP mode.
Keybind names now show properly in the controls menu.

versions.title: New HUD modules and Safe Logout

New: Five new HUD modules: Keystrokes / CPS, Armor Status, Potion Effects, Compass and Biome / Time. They are off by default, turn them on from their cards.
Safe Logout: quitting is guarded for 30 seconds after combat, so you can't leave a fight by accident.
Improved: The HUD menu has < > page buttons (or use the mouse wheel) when there are more modules than fit.
When a screen corner is full, the next HUD modules start a second column instead of going off screen.
Fixed: Fixes for Minecraft 26.2 (Safe Logout and the pause menu guard).

New: A Check for updates button in the Tools tab. It works even if automatic checking is turned off.
Improved: The update checker no longer depends on GitHub's rate-limited API, so it keeps working on shared networks.

New: A What's New popup now opens once on the title screen after you update the mod.
Control Center > Tools has a What's New button to read the notes again any time.
Improved: If you skipped a few versions, the notes of every version you missed are listed together.
